description: baseline_v1 with prefix caching OFF; everything else identical
notes: Ablation of baseline_v1: only change is `--no-enable-prefix-caching`. Same seed, rates, durations and replay, so every request matches baseline_v1 one-to-one. Rate grids come from a calibration sweep (1 repeat x 90 s per rate, results not kept): each starts well below and ends past the rate where completions stopped keeping up with arrivals (scheduler ~11-12, baseline ~1, kv_cache ~0.2-0.3 req/s). Lower-rate scenarios run longer so each run still has enough requests for tail percentiles. Replay: 2024-05-14 10:00-16:00 UTC, trace load 54 -> 75 (14:00 peak) -> 65 req/s; x6 speedup (1 h run) and rate_scale 0.0019 give ~0.75 req/s average, ~0.86 at the peak. ~8 GPU-hours, ~3.5-4 h wall clock.
